summary: /recipe give or take for one recipe says "recipes"
description:
The Bug
When doing /recipe give or take for only one item the text says "recipes" despite it being one item.
Replicate
- Do /recipe give @s acacia_sign
 Notice that it says recipes instead of recipe

Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Open the chat and run `/recipe give @s acacia_sign`.
4. Observe that the success message uses “recipes” even though only one recipe was given.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.3, 1.16.4 Pre-release 1, 1.16.4 Pre-release 2, 1.16.4 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.4, 20w45a, 20w46a, 20w48a, 20w49a, 20w51a, 21w03a, 1.16.5 Release Candidate 1, 21w05b, 21w06a, 21w07a, 21w13a, 21w14a, 21w15a, 21w16a, 21w17a, 1.17, 1.17.1, 1.18, 1.18.1, 1.18.2, 22w11a, 1.19, 1.19.2, 1.19.3, 1.19.4 Pre-release 1, 1.19.4, 23w18a, 1.20 Release Candidate 1, 1.20, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.21.3 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior:
### Actual behavior

When `/recipe give` or `/recipe take` affects exactly one recipe, the command succeeds but its feedback message incorrectly uses the plural **“recipes”** instead of the singular **“recipe.”**

For example:

```text
/recipe give @s acacia_sign
```

displays a message equivalent to:

```text
Unlocked 1 recipes for <player>
```

The corresponding `/recipe take` command similarly displays:

```text
Took 1 recipes from <player>
```

The issue affects the single-recipe success messages associated with:

- `commands.recipe.give.success.single`
- `commands.recipe.take.success.single`

Plural wording is grammatically incorrect when the recipe count is `1`.
Expected Behavior: When using `/recipe give` or `/recipe take` for a single recipe, the success message should use the singular wording “recipe” rather than “recipes.” The corresponding messages should accurately reflect whether one recipe or multiple recipes are affected, including the correct wording for single and multiple players, so commands such as `/recipe give @s acacia_sign` display a grammatically appropriate result.
